parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset

parameters.name: filters[plan_item_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Item ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[plan_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan ID(s)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Direction (asc/desc) can be controlled by the presence or absence of '-' before the sort parameter.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Action Plan reference.

plan_item_id.description: ID of the Action Plan item this reference is attached to.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this reference was created.

payload.description: Type-specific payload containing identifiers for the referenced resource. The fields present depend on the value of the type field.

drawing_id.description: ID of the Drawing that contains the referenced revision.

drawing_revision_id.description: ID of the current Drawing Revision for the referenced Drawing.

file_version_id.description: ID of the current File Version for the referenced Document.

folder_id.description: ID of the Folder containing the referenced Document.

specification_section_id.description: ID of the referenced Specification Section.

specification_section_current_revision_i.description: ID of the current revision of the referenced Specification Section. Null if no revision exists.

submittal_log_id.description: ID of the referenced Submittal Log entry.

generic_tool_item_id.description: ID of the referenced Generic Tool Item (Correspondence).

generic_tool_id.description: ID of the Generic Tool (Correspondence tool) that the referenced item belongs to. Present when the reference type is generic_tool_item.

observation_item_id.description: ID of the referenced Observation Item.

image_id.description: ID of the referenced image. Present when the reference type is image.

viewer_url.description: URL to open the referenced item in the Procore web viewer. Present for attachment, form, image, and document management reference types.

collection_id.description: Document collection ID for a document management reference.

container_id.description: Document container ID for a document management reference.

document_revision_id.description: Document revision ID for a document management reference. Null for open items showing the latest revision.

document_name.description: Name of the referenced document management document.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan that owns the item this reference is attached to.

type.description: Type of resource this reference points to.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this reference was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this reference was soft-deleted. Null if the reference is active.
